title: looks_like_bcrypt_hash split from parse_bcrypt_cost — correct factoring
description: The commit correctly split the length check (len >= 60) into looks_like_bcrypt_hash() rather than folding it into parse_bcrypt_cost(). parse_bcrypt_cost is used internally in make_dummy_hash where only the cost field matters; the length check is a defence-in-depth guard for operator input validation. A future contributor might want to collapse these back into one function 'for simplicity' — resist that: the two functions serve different callers with different requirements.
